title: Offline Learning Portal
description: Offline Learning Portal v1.1.0: a Windows school LAN resource portal with interactive NGINX/NSSM installation and removal, free-port selection, IP-and-port device links, a local catalogue and three user guides. Windows acceptance was confirmed by the creator; portable checks and evidence boundaries are documented. Original files use MIT; bundled components retain their notices. Optional Kiwix is separately configured. Creator/contact: Tirtharaj Dhungana, tirtharajdhungana84@gmail.com. AI assistance is acknowledged in ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md.
